inlineSql: Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
SELECT UPI_TYPE As UpiTypeL From UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND UPI_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY UPI_TYPE

SELECT TOP(1) GR_RATE AS FINE_GL_RATE FROM RATE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND GR_CODE = '22K' ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.* ,B.AC_NAME FROM AD_OS AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LD_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK <> '076' ORDER BY A.SCHM_DATE

Select A.*,B.SCHM_TYPE From AD_MEMB AS A LEFT JOIN AD_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE As MembCodeL,A.MEMB_NAME as MembNameL,A.AC_ADD1 AS AddressL,A.MEMB_AMT AS SchmAmtR FROM AD_MEMB AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.EXP_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ORDER BY A.MEMB_CODE

SELECT SCHM_CODE,MEMB_CODE,SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE -ADJ_AMT END) As Bal FROM AD_OS AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY SCHM_CODE,MEMB_CODE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN ADJ_AMT ELSE -ADJ_AMT END) > 0
